description: Send a message to a group you belong to. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

file_url.description: https:// URL or empty string, at most 512 bytes

new_message.description: UTF-8 text, at most 2048 bytes; no control or invisible characters

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

name: geode_messaging_send_message_to_group
title: Messaging: send message to group
